Session settings

New combinations of ramps and patterns are chosen after each registered edge. Her style and the day’s circumstances influence the surprises. Your configured power caps, Civet cutoff and automatic recovery always apply. Switch this off to use the fixed setup below.

Adaptive recovery details

A shift of 0.25 means a quarter-cycle. 0.5 makes the waves opposite. Floors do not affect Together mode.
